purpose: Admit deterministic cloud-path labels from immutable provider-native runtime evidence while distinguishing exact-target decisions, universal action-scope decisions, and incomplete but security-relevant observations.
required_source_properties: fixed upstream revision or locally preserved artifact with SHA-256
required_common_path_properties: the start identity or workload is present in runtime evidence
the cloud-data target or provider operation scope is explicit
every critical relationship has immutable raw references
scenario and lineage deduplication is enforced

required: provider-native explicit denial or dependency-state error
same-target success control or independent provider evidence that the target exists
no contrary success by the denied principal in the same state
provider error text naming the denied action
provider error text covering a wildcard resource scope or a resource-independent catalogue action
no contrary success by the denied principal in the same state
universal_action_scope_denial.semantic_limit: The verdict applies only to the named operation and provider resource scope at the recorded time; it cannot be generalized to other APIs or later states.
universal_action_scope_denial.target_existence_control: not required because authorization is rejected before or independently of target lookup

required: exact resource or exact batch of named resources
no contrary provider outcome for the selected state
exact external principal, account, or public grantee
all provider-documented mandatory conditions needed for that permission to be effective
effective_permission_exposure.semantic_limit: Reachable means the data resource was exposed through an effective provider permission; it does not claim that the external principal actually copied or queried the data.

required_when_any_apply: a dangerous configuration change is observed but an independent blocker state is missing
an API call succeeds but the response does not prove any exact data resource was returned
credentials or passwords change but network reachability and a successful data-plane operation are unobserved
a share permission is recorded but encryption or KMS prerequisites for the external account are incomplete

forbidden_shortcuts: manual or walkthrough used directly as gold
missing finding interpreted as not exposed
credentials obtained interpreted as data read without a data operation
successful API request interpreted as non-empty data retrieval when the response is absent
public ACL interpreted as effective public access without relevant Block Public Access state or an anonymous access observation
share permission interpreted as effective encrypted-data access without required KMS evidence
repeated retries counted as independent cases
human_role: Audit semantic mappings and source-admission disputes; do not overwrite provider allow or deny decisions by intuition.
